tip: blev plus a participle like försenat marks a change that happened to the subject, unlike vara which just states a fact.
Add -s to make the passive: skrevs = was written. The doer follows av, so skrevs av Astrid Lindgren means written by her.
hjälptes åt uses the -s to mean each other, so hjälptes åt att bära = helped one another carry, not a passive.
skäms always keeps -s but is active, not passive, and takes för for the thing: skäms för misstaget = ashamed of the mistake.
lär here does not mean learn. It signals hearsay or likelihood, so saken lär inte vara avgjord = the matter probably isn't decided.
vore is the what-if form of vara, meaning would be for unreal situations: det vore önskvärt = it would be desirable.
Start a clause with something other than the subject and the verb stays second: Med god vilja löser vi, so löser comes before vi.
